content: To reset your account password, open Settings -> Security -> Reset Password. Follow the email link sent to your registered email address to enter a new secure password.
Users can change their account email address and profile notification preferences from the General Settings panel.
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) setup requires binding an Authenticator app (e.g., Google Authenticator) or entering TOTP verification codes during login.
Subscription Refund Policy: Customers are eligible for a full refund within 14 days of purchase if monthly software usage is below 100 API credits.
Invoices and monthly payment receipts can be downloaded as PDF documents from the Billing History tab.
Database Connection Pooling: Set minPoolSize=5 and maxPoolSize=50 in PostgreSQL configuration to prevent client connection starvation during peak traffic spikes.
Handling API HTTP 429 Rate Limits: Clients encountering 429 Too Many Requests should implement exponential backoff retry algorithms with randomized jitter.

content: Multi-Tenant Data Security: Tenant data must be segregated using tenant-id database predicates or schema isolation to enforce zero cross-tenant access leakage.
